_comment: Conductor budget guard config. windowCeilingUSD is intentionally null; the conductor setup wizard writes it on first run from your ccusage history. Edit any field; re-run the wizard with `conductor/conductor.sh --budget-setup` to reset the ceiling. Values are a USD proxy for how much of a Claude usage window you are willing to spend per 5h block (subscription users do not pay per token, but cost tracks rate-limit consumption).
_perAgentMaxUSD_note: Hard --max-budget-usd cap per dispatched implementer (Claude Code 2.1.x). Aborts a runaway agent; its git commits survive and it can be re-dispatched. Set null to disable.
